records.author_interpretation: OQLF identifies centimètre as n. m. and lists cm with its symbol-writing rules. Wiktionnaire supplies the exact French cm pronunciation and the centimètre noun definition explicitly identifying cm as its symbol. The proposal retains the frozen cm/NOM membership while exposing the source symbol classification; it does not claim that cm is an independently attested lexical noun or that NOM is the source symbol label. The symbol has no plural ending or abbreviation point; centimètre is its nominal spoken reading. Independent construction/classification review remains pending.
